title: Let's trade: play my game about laundering money, I'll play yours
author: valval166
selftext:
Hey, I published my game on CrazyGames a couple of days ago.  
I can see there are some issues with the gameplay. I'd be glad to hear any thoughts, what worked and what didn't.

**To keep it fair, share your web games too.** I'll play each one and leave my thoughts.  
But **web only**, guys, on **trusted platforms** \- itch, Unity Play, and so on.

Let the game exchange begin!

comments.author: EffectNo2152
comments.body:
https://jalapenoseed.itch.io/yolkflip

adding updates today always more eggs to hatch

replies.author: valval166
replies.body:
Really cool and fun idea, I genuinely liked it, but I ran into some technical issues: the gyro didn't turn on for me on my phone (tried a few browsers), and it could use some optimization, it's a bit laggy.

The game window with the frying pan looks awesome.  
You should add pancakes too. And maybe some fun items that you're not supposed to fry.

replies.author: EffectNo2152
replies.body: yes i noticed some of that too. i am a few updates behind on there and i think i accidentally let grok edit it last. thanks for looking.

comments.author: RUSuper
comments.body:
Tried it, I think onboarding should be a bit better. Right now it tells me what to click and by clicking it you progress further then again what to click again, but I want to know "why I'm clicking this" like small box with text "press here to do XYZ". Basically to know why I did each thing. Animations are cute and models are also nice stylish ones. But some "dealer in casino" type of girl explaining things to you in the beginning would mean nice, then you follow through the "tutorial". 

As for my game it is not web game so it requires install so yeah.

replies.author: valval166
replies.body:
Thanks, is your game on itch? I only have a Mac, that's why I suggested web specifically. Anyway, drop the link.  
I'll work through your feedback. I was aiming to simplify the gameplay as much as possible, cutting out everything unnecessary, but maybe I overdid it.

replies.author: RUSuper
replies.body:
Nah it's not on itch, but don't worry. Also Mac has problems with my game as it is GPU bound (at least my MacBook Air M4 is struggling hard with it, while PCs with proper GPUs have no problems).

Yeah I feel like if people are struggling to understand what to do and why they are doing it when they start a game, they just leave it right away.

comments.author: phira
comments.body:
I gave it a go and I admit I kinda got a bit lost - I couldn't really work out what I was supposed to be doing. 

The tutorial bit was fine in that I learned how to roll the dice, get a stack, connect some roads, but once that had happened I found myself sitting kinda scratching my head. I earned a couple more dice rolls, got another two stacks, didn't even have to do a road for one of them it just auto-connected where it landed. I managed to spend some money buying more space, and sometimes there were piles of cash that spawned on the ground next to the big pile and I could click those to make them disappear and get more money.

There was another thing that I managed to pop up a couple of times that offered to make the stacks bigger or charge the dice, but I didn't really understand why I'd want either of those things - in particular there was a reference to a "Tax man" that would come if the stacks got too big and I presumed that was something I'd need to be managing somehow but I wasn't sure how.

Overall the interactions worked just fine and the graphics were cute. The trucks were perhaps a touch small? larger would just feel nicer I think, but maybe there's piles of them later on.

replies.author: valval166
replies.body: Thanks for the detailed feedback. As I understand it, the goal and the overall point aren't clear from the start, while the mechanical explanations work fine, there's just not enough info about what's actually happening. Is that right?

replies.author: phira
replies.body: I think so. I really wasn't sure what I was even trying to do - I presume I was trying to get as much money as possible but I never really had a sense of what "good" was or what was getting in the way of getting more. Sorry I'm not necessarily super helpful here!

replies.author: valval166
replies.body: No no, you helped a lot, thank you very much.

comments.author: Kelfezond11
comments.body: No, because yours is considerably better and I am now embarrassed :P

replies.author: valval166
replies.body: No worries, I'm a developer too, I can help with stuff. My game isn't working anyway, so relax.

replies.author: Kelfezond11
replies.body: Haha 😂 I'm glad it's not just me that occasionally just has to say "Okay it's broken again, sorry" after making a change
